name: Barnard's Star
caption: Fastest-moving star in our sky. It saturates: watch the bright core shift between windows.

name: Epsilon Indi B
caption: A brown-dwarf pair moving with its bright star, Epsilon Indi A.

name: WISE 0855−0714
caption: The coldest known brown dwarf. Moves about 1.3 px a year: watch the D6 stack.

name: RW Aurigae
caption: A young star that dims and brightens. Look for brightness change, not motion.

name: R Draconis
caption: A pulsating red giant with a ~245-day cycle. Watch it brighten and fade.
